name: XO Armor
headline: Scan-to-print software that cut custom orthotics from weeks to under an hour
overview: XO Armor lets clinics and athletic programs 3D-print custom orthotics on site. Techlio built the core software: the iPhone scanning app, the desktop customization software, the subscription and ordering portal, and the dashboard and database that tie it together.

challenges.title: Weeks-long turnaround
challenges.text: Custom splints and braces were fabricated off site, leaving patients waiting or settling for poor fits.

challenges.title: Scanning without specialist hardware
challenges.text: Accurate 3D capture normally required expensive scanners and trained technicians.

challenges.title: Design tools built for engineers
challenges.text: Turning a scan into a printable device demanded CAD expertise clinicians do not have.

challenges.title: Operations across a growing network
challenges.text: Subscriptions, catalogs, print activity and support needed one system.

solutions.title: iPhone 3D scanning app
solutions.text: Captures an accurate model of a hand, wrist, foot or ankle in about 30 seconds on a phone.

solutions.title: Scan-to-print customization software
solutions.text: Desktop software that produces a print-ready device with controls for material, padding and coverage, no CAD skills needed.

solutions.title: Guided on-site workflow
solutions.text: Scanning, design and the clinic's printer connected in one offline-capable workflow.

solutions.title: Subscription portal and admin dashboard
solutions.text: Ordering, the device catalog and tracking for clinics, users, devices and print activity.

results: 50+ clinics and programs, including Auburn, Louisville and the New Orleans Saints
10K+ custom devices printed through the platform
45 to 60 minute scan-to-print turnaround, down from weeks
2K+ subscribers managing devices and orders through the portal
architecture: A React Native iPhone app captures the 3D scan, Electron desktop software with Three.js handles customisation and print preparation, and a Node.js API on PostgreSQL and AWS connects clinics, subscriptions and the admin dashboard.
